findings.text: follow-on: the launcher's first guard refuses a pointer-pid-alive run with "still has a live process" and names no pid, so the goal's pid naming holds only for the worker-record shape and this message is frozen by parity with dispatch.py:10676, so it cannot be extended from this module.

follow-on: the done-when's fold-in -- no exit record while an adopted worker lives -- is half met; the reader half is pinned here, but the signal short-circuit in _reap_the_launched_worker still lets the supervisor write an early exit record and dispatch.py is outside this node's write scope.

follow-on: the real-crew-home isolation receipt iterates _RUN_IDS ("r-manual-live-worker", "r-sweep-live-worker", "r-live-under-record") while the sweep case at line 309 writes "r-sweep-live-under-record", so a leak of that case's paths into the live home is not caught by the receipt.
